Messages.Author: Hannigan
Messages.Body:
Ricki Van Demsi is in combat, at zero blood, and gets hit for one. I
play Undead Persistance, to keep her from torpor, and hit back for
one. I then play Taste of Vitae(drawing a Skin of Rock), to give
Ricki a blood. I use the press from Undead Persistance, and combat
goes another round.

If I prevent the damage from the opposing punch with my Skin of Rock,
is Ricki still going to torpor, or can she now prevent the damage she
took last round with the blood that she has since gained?

Or does something else happen?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Ricki is not "going to torpor" (card text on Undead Persistence).

After combat, Ricki goes to torpor (card text on Undead Persistence).

Other effects don't change that (except the possibility of removing
Ricki from play - usually by burning - before the end of combat).

In any event, damage cannot be retroactively prevented.
Also, blood doesn't prevent damage. Vampires use blood to heal damage,
but this is not the same as preventing it. Damage cannot be
restroactively healed, either.
